title: Measure latency where the user feels it
body: Turn latency endpoint detected to first audible token measured on the server. p50 and p95 comparable across sessions and languages. arabic endpointing penalty.

title: A payment webhook will fire twice
body: Payment providers retry webhook delivery on ambiguous response. Idempotency key checked inside the same transaction as the side effect. Idempotent handler prevents double charge.

title: A working local demo says nothing about the network path
body: WebRTC STUN TURN relay NAT traversal jitter mobile network. Direct connection via STUN is the fast path, TURN relay is the fallback on restrictive networks.

title: An unscored prompt change is a guess
body: Evaluation set scoring prompt changes production. Any prompt change that touches production should run against the same scored evaluation set.
